name: Kalnama AI Search
author: jazxinnovation

sections.description:
Kalnama AI Search provides local, API-free intelligent search for WordPress.

Core release features include:

  • Urdu and English text and voice search profiles.
  • Support for public WordPress post types and public taxonomies.
  • Generic Index v2 for searchable WordPress content.
  • Local Ranking v3.1.
  • Local Alias Intelligence and query expansion.
  • Browser-based voice search where supported.
  • Automatic indexing and full reindex tools.
  • Admin dashboard, diagnostics, settings and logs.
  • No external AI API key required.
  • No per-query AI API charges.

The core search, indexing, ranking and alias intelligence run locally with WordPress/PHP/database data.

Kalnama AI Search Free remains fully usable on its own with Urdu and English. An optional separate Kalnama AI Search Pro add-on provides 80+ language profiles, advanced multilingual search intelligence, analytics and search controls. The Kalnama admin area includes a contextual Pro information page that links to the official JAZ-X store when Pro is not active and recognizes the separate Pro add-on when it is active.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate Kalnama AI Search.
  2. Open Kalnama AI Search in the WordPress admin area.
  3. Review Search Settings and language options.
  4. Build or rebuild the search index.
  5. Test text and voice search on the frontend.
sections.faq:
Does the core plugin require an external AI API key?

No. Version 1.0.7 uses an API-free local search architecture.

What is the default primary language?

Urdu is the default primary language. The Free edition includes Urdu and English profiles; Kalnama Pro adds 80+ language profiles.

Does voice search send audio to an external AI provider?

Kalnama AI Search uses the browser’s supported speech-recognition capability for voice input. The plugin’s core search engine itself does not require an external AI API.

Is Kalnama AI Search Free usable without the Pro add-on?

Yes. The free plugin remains fully usable without purchasing or activating Kalnama AI Search Pro. Pro is a separate optional add-on for additional features.
sections.changelog:
1.0.9

  • Focused the Free edition on Urdu and English language profiles.
  • Added strict server-side validation so unsupported language profiles cannot remain enabled in Free.
  • Added an in-context Pro notice for users who need 80+ language profiles.
  • Updated new-install language defaults to enable Urdu and English.

1.0.8

  • Maintenance and release metadata update.

1.0.7

  • Added a contextual Kalnama Pro information and upgrade page within the Kalnama admin menu.
  • Added detection of the separate Kalnama AI Search Pro add-on, including its active version.
  • Added a direct admin link to the Pro dashboard when the Pro add-on is active.
  • Updated plugin author branding to JAZ-X Innovation.
  • Kept the free search, indexing, ranking and voice-search functionality independent of the optional Pro add-on.

1.0.6

  • Fixed admin-driven reindex progress so authenticated polling can process batches while WP-Cron remains a fallback.
  • Aligned live search and ranking normalization with the Generic Index for Urdu/Arabic glyph variants.
  • Fixed logging setting/debug-key inconsistencies and enabled diagnostic logging by default for new installs.
  • Corrected the WordPress.org stable tag for the hotfix release.
  • Hardened frontend inline JSON configuration against closing-script injection and made the logger enforce the Logging setting.

1.0.4

  • API-free local search architecture.
  • Generic Index v2 fresh-install schema alignment.
  • Multilingual and Urdu-first search improvements.
  • Local Ranking v3.1 and Alias Intelligence.
  • Voice-search and floating-search UI fixes.
  • Security, AJAX, logging and release-integrity hardening.
  • Removed retired Claude/semantic runtime dependencies and legacy release files.
